name: turnos-app-firebase
description: Herramientas de Firebase para la app de turnos (emuladores; design.md §6).

scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-turnos
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-turnos "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
